picks.title: Google announces the Fitbit Edge, a middle ground between Pixel Watch 5 and Fitbit Air
picks.excerpt: The Fitbit Edge offers more than the Air, but it's not a real smartwatch.
picks.rationale: An official new wearable from Google, announced on 10-12, that sits between the Fitbit Air and the Pixel Watch. It is a concrete launch, not a leak.

picks.title: Google Translate could soon auto-save transcripts of your Live conversations (Updated: Rolling out)
picks.excerpt: Google Translate is testing an “Auto-save transcript” toggle for Live Translate; transcript saving is disabled entirely when smart glasses are connected, to protect privacy.
picks.rationale: Live Translate auto-saved transcripts are now rolling out, and saving switches off when smart glasses connect. That is a concrete privacy design choice for AI wearables.

picks.title: Googlebook OS review: A post-smartphone PC, if Google can keep it
picks.excerpt: All attempts to bring the lessons and benefits of the touch era to PCs have failed, from Windows 8 to...
picks.rationale: The first in-depth review of Google's AI-first laptop OS on shipping hardware. It covers the whole platform rather than one laptop.

picks.title: RTX Spark mini PC promises to overcome memory limitations using Mechrevo's unusual AI SSD
picks.excerpt: Mechrevo's upcoming Master Road X10 mini PC combines Nvidia RTX Spark hardware with proprietary AI SSD technology, which the maker claims can accommodate AI models with up to 122 billion parameters.
picks.rationale: A newly announced RTX Spark mini PC that pairs the chip with an SSD it says can hold 122B-parameter models. It is a different way around the local-AI memory limit.

picks.title: Meta has some Wonder Full new AI models
picks.excerpt: Meta says the models compete with the industry’s best and will soon power its Muse agent.
picks.rationale: Meta released its new Wonder Full models, which will soon power the Muse agent on its smart glasses. This is the model layer behind Meta's gadgets.

alternates.title: Motorola Razr Ultra 2026: Android 17 update brings programmable AI key, themed icons, and more
alternates.excerpt: Owners of the Motorola Razr Ultra 2026 are receiving the Android 17 update, which adds a programmable AI key, themed icons, a new look and enhanced security.
alternates.rationale: A rolling update that adds a programmable AI key to a shipping foldable.

alternates.title: MSI reveals new 16-inch, 128GB beast powered by Nvidia RTX Spark
alternates.excerpt: Five big brands beat MSI to Nvidia’s RTX Spark laptops, so here is what the latecomer is bringing along.
alternates.rationale: A new RTX Spark laptop from MSI with 128GB of memory. It is a new product in an already-covered launch wave.

alternates.title: Gemini’s floating overlay may soon help you ‘Shop this’ right from your screen
alternates.excerpt: Google is working on a new “Shop this” suggestion for Gemini’s pop-up overlay that would recognize on-screen products, summarize selling points and offer comparisons.
alternates.rationale: An APK teardown showing on-screen product recognition coming to Gemini's overlay. It is not yet shipped.

https://arstechnica.com/gadgets/2026/10/.new_action: Google officially announced and launched the Fitbit Edge on 2026-10-12. The 10-07 Digital Trends card was a pre-launch rumor; this card reports the official product announcement.

https://9to5google.com/2026/10/12/google.new_action: Googlebook hardware is now shipping and has been reviewed; this is the first full OS review, not the 09-22 lineup announcement or the 09-26 widget-app listing.
